subskills.task: For every physical PDF page, identify the drawing number, title, drawing type, and physical page using title-block text and page content. Preserve multiple plausible identities as alternatives rather than selecting by filename or date.
constraints: A calendar date is not a drawing number.
Cite the page and visible identity evidence.
Do not infer a missing revision from neighboring sheets.
subskills.failure: Return needs_review for ambiguous identity; retain the page and alternatives.

subskills.task: Read revision marks and issue status for each identified sheet; determine which revision is current only where the document index or explicit issue evidence establishes precedence. Keep superseded and conflicting sheets visible.
constraints: Do not assume the latest-looking date wins without matching issue/revision evidence.
Do not combine geometry across conflicting revisions without explicit equivalence.
subskills.failure: Mark revision scope needs_review and flag affected cross-sheet links.

subskills.task: Link plans, dimensions, sections, elevations, schedules, and details only when sheet references, tags, level labels, or matching geometry support the relationship. Record relationship type and evidence on both ends.
constraints: Never link solely because pages are adjacent or have similar titles.
Do not link superseded revisions as current evidence.
subskills.failure: Leave unproven pages unlinked and return the missing reference needed.

subskills.task: Extract candidate project-site addresses, suburbs, site names, coordinates, north arrows, survey bearings, and location clues from site plans, title blocks, and the brief. Rank project-site clues above consultant office addresses and cite each candidate.
constraints: Do not treat consultant addresses as project locations without evidence.
Do not treat an address as façade orientation.
No external lookup in this task.
subskills.failure: Return candidates and ambiguity; do not silently select a site.

subskills.task: Present the highest-ranked site-address candidates and their cited evidence for explicit user confirmation. Record corrections as contractor-provided evidence and do not start geocoding before confirmation and project consent.
constraints: AI cannot confirm an address for the user.
No coordinates or weather are resolved from an unconfirmed address.
subskills.failure: Pause lookup and ask the contractor to correct or confirm the address.

subskills.task: After address confirmation, match the location and selected comfort/critical basis to current released Australian design-weather records; return cited cooling and heating candidates with scope and applicability.
constraints: Never substitute live forecast or ordinary station observations for HVAC design conditions.
Do not use expired or out-of-scope records.
External research requires recorded project/run consent and allowlisted sources.
subskills.failure: Return no eligible candidate and identify the missing pack/source requirement.

subskills.task: Identify distinct conditioned and process spaces from room labels, partitions, furniture, fixtures, equipment, finishes, and adjacency clues. Preserve original labels and classify only into the controlled room-use taxonomy.
constraints: Do not merge distinct rooms because labels are similar.
Do not infer numerical loads or schedules from room type.
Keep kitchen process scope separate; exclude refrigeration/plant from comfort scope.
subskills.failure: Retain ambiguous room candidates as needs_review with a specific clue needed.

subskills.task: Resolve a measured floor-area candidate for every in-scope room or conditioned zone the evidence supports. Use the current-revision primary dimensioned plan. Trace the inside-face boundary and build its polygon in millimetres using written dimension chains; do not use pixel-scaled area on a sheet that says not to scale. The dimension_wall_matches index is a convenience, not a gate: when the rendered PDF crop visibly shows the numeric dimension and its extension/witness lines, you may transcribe that printed dimension into a candidate record with a stable dimension ID, value_mm, physical page, crop/bounding box, and excerpt. Link it to a wall only when the printed extension/witness lines visibly terminate at that wall's inside faces, or derive a wall length from a complete cited chain whose operands and signed relationship are explicit. Return ordered boundary_points_mm, coordinate_units='mm', ordered wall IDs, a wall record for every segment, and dimension links sufficient for the resolver to verify every edge length and recompute the shoelace area. Do not merely copy an AI-reported area. If a dimension chain does not close or leaves any material edge unmeasured, preserve the candidate as unresolved. Return each room independently; one blocked room must not suppress another supported area.
constraints: Never derive area from visual proportion, furniture size, tile count, or an unrelated dimension.
Use exact normalized room IDs/labels supplied in room_candidates; distinguish a room from a functional subarea and do not double-count nested/overlapping zones.
Use only current-revision dimensioned plan pages for primary geometry; finish/RCP pages support identity or independent witness only.
Where a room opens into a connected zone, resolve one parent zone's complete non-overlapping boundary or explicitly mark the subarea non-counting; never invent a closure.
Visually read dimensions only when the printed value and its extension/witness relationship are legible; include a crop/bounding box and transcription excerpt.
Every polygon edge must be measured by a direct dimension or explicit cited dimension-chain derivation; unmeasured return/offset/column edges block that room.
Reject open, self-intersecting, branched, duplicate, or competing loops.
The deterministic resolver recomputes area from boundary_points_mm; never trust area_m2 supplied by the AI.
A room with incomplete geometry remains an explicit unresolved candidate naming the missing dimension, edge, boundary ownership, or level.
subskills.failure: Block only the affected room. Identify the exact missing edge, dimension chain, boundary owner, revision, or level; do not substitute pixel scaling or generic area fallback.

subskills.task: Resolve floor-to-finished-ceiling height from explicitly scoped RCP, section, elevation, or ceiling notes; derive room volume from current validated area and cited height. Keep ceiling voids separate.
constraints: Do not use door/joinery/detail dimensions or apply shared height beyond explicit scope.
Flag double-height and raked ceilings.
A controlled fallback must be explicitly labelled provisional.
subskills.failure: Keep volume unresolved when area or applicable finished-ceiling height is missing.

subskills.task: Count legible seats, workstations, beds, or other occupancy indicators; distinguish a counted quantity from a room-use density estimate and retain the evidence used for each.
constraints: Count symbols only when distinguishable and room-owned.
Do not invent occupancy density or operating diversity.
Use controlled profile only as a labelled draft fallback.
subskills.failure: Return occupancy as unresolved with evidence/remediation rather than zero.

subskills.task: Identify lighting fixture types and room-owned quantities from lighting/RCP drawings and schedules; retain wattage only when explicitly stated or selected from a released scoped record.
constraints: Do not count decorative symbols or fixtures outside the room boundary.
Do not infer watts from appearance.
Keep W/m² profiles labelled provisional.
subskills.failure: Leave unsupported fixture power unresolved; retain visible counts as evidence.

subskills.task: Identify room-owned equipment, model/tag, quantity, rated input, and heat-to-space evidence from plans and schedules. Separate equipment presence from its thermal contribution.
constraints: Equipment identity/count does not establish input power or heat-to-space factor.
Do not count shared equipment in multiple rooms.
Unknown heat rejection is not zero.
subskills.failure: Retain the equipment record as evidence-only and exclude its gain until supported.

subskills.task: Extract explicit weekday, Saturday, Sunday, holiday, and operating-hour statements and map them to controlled schedules without inventing operating hours from a business type.
constraints: Preserve explicit hours and day types.
Schedule values must be bounded 0..1 and have 24 hourly entries.
Controlled defaults remain provisional.
subskills.failure: Leave unsupported schedules unresolved; do not assume all-day operation.

subskills.task: Inventory physical walls, roofs, floors, ceilings, and partitions with room/zone ownership, adjacency, thermal role, and cited drawing geometry.
constraints: Use one canonical record for shared boundaries.
Do not create surfaces from legends, title blocks, or 3D-only objects.
Do not invent missing geometry.
subskills.failure: Retain expected-but-unseen surfaces as unresolved coverage issues.

subskills.task: Derive gross and net surface areas from validated geometry and resolved height, then subtract only confirmed openings with complete host-wall coverage.
constraints: Retain gross and net separately.
Subtract each opening exactly once.
Incomplete opening coverage blocks only its host wall.
subskills.failure: Block area contribution where geometry or opening coverage is incomplete.

subskills.task: Match surface construction tags and descriptions to cited project/supplier records or released scoped assemblies; propose compatible IDs, not arbitrary U-values.
constraints: Do not infer an uncited U-value from a finish or image alone.
Verify location, surface category, revision, and validity scope.
Fallbacks must be marked draft-only.
subskills.failure: Leave construction unresolved or use only an explicitly controlled preliminary fallback.

subskills.task: Classify each surface boundary as outdoor, ground-contact, fixed adjacent, or dynamic room-to-room and attach its eligible cited temperature source.
constraints: Outdoor uses selected design weather only.
Do not assign a generic adjacent-space temperature.
Room coupling requires both owners and its method gate.
subskills.failure: Exclude only the affected surface when boundary ownership or temperature is unsupported.

subskills.task: Match opening sightings across plans, elevations, sections, schedules, and photos using tags, level, host wall, sequence, and landmarks; retain competing matches.
constraints: Do not merge repeated tags across levels/revisions without corroboration.
Do not silently select between competing owners.
Keep unmatched sightings visible.
subskills.failure: Mark ambiguous match blocked and identify the conflicting sightings.

subskills.task: Resolve opening area, glass area, overall-window U-value, and exactly one solar property (SHGC or transmission) from cited schedules, supplier sources, released packs, or explicit provisional visual class.
constraints: Visual-only values are draft provisional, never reviewed.
Do not invent product ratings.
Do not set both SHGC and transmission active for one system.
subskills.failure: Exclude only unsupported opening property contributions; preserve geometry evidence.

subskills.task: Determine whether each opening is external or internal, then resolve host-wall outward true-north azimuth from cited north-arrow, survey, or approved map alignment.
constraints: Address alone never proves orientation.
Internal tenancy/mall glazing receives no outdoor weather/solar load.
Retain degrees for angled façades.
subskills.failure: Leave solar excluded when exposure, host side, or alignment is ambiguous.

subskills.task: Select a cited design-day radiation series compatible with the resolved site, date/hour convention, timezone, scenario, and approved radiation method.
constraints: No live forecast substitution.
Do not mix weather/radiation scenarios or timezone conventions.
Use only approved source/method records.
subskills.failure: Exclude solar component and name the missing compatible source or method gate.

subskills.task: Identify overhang, fin, reveal, obstruction, and internal-blind evidence for each opening; keep direct, diffuse, and internal shading treatments separate.
constraints: Do not apply one factor twice or to total irradiance without method support.
Do not infer dimensions from appearance alone.
Unknown shading remains explicit.
subskills.failure: Retain an unresolved shading issue or explicit unshaded draft assumption.

subskills.task: Resolve room/zone outside air from explicit mechanical inputs or scoped requirements using occupancy and area evidence; distinguish people, area, fixed, and combined bases.
constraints: Do not invent airflow values.
Keep required outside air separate from infiltration, exhaust, and transfer.
Preserve chosen rate record and formula operands.
subskills.failure: Leave affected room/zone outside air unresolved; retain any other valid paths.

subskills.task: Resolve uncontrolled infiltration only from cited ACH/airflow, explicit leakage/door exposure evidence, accepted profile, or visible controlled draft fallback; use resolved room volume for ACH conversion.
constraints: Never reuse outside-air schedule as infiltration schedule.
Do not invent leakage rates from a door symbol alone.
Fallback must be named and provisional.
subskills.failure: Keep infiltration unresolved without converting missing data to zero.

subskills.task: Identify process/general exhaust systems and their served rooms, hoods, fans, and explicitly supported flow rates; distinguish comfort ventilation from process exhaust.
constraints: Do not infer exhaust airflow from hood presence alone.
Do not count the same path at room and system level.
Missing process flow must remain explicit.
subskills.failure: Keep comfort-room load eligible and exclude unresolved process-air contribution.

subskills.task: Trace replacement-air sources and conditioning ownership for exhaust, accounting for explicitly documented transfer-air and outside-air credits.
constraints: Transfer air is not outdoor air.
Do not assign conditioning ownership without a source.
Avoid negative required make-up flow.
subskills.failure: Block the process-air contribution until flow and ownership are resolved.

subskills.task: Reconcile canonical air-path identities across room, zone, and system records to prevent duplicate outside air, infiltration, exhaust, transfer, and make-up contributions.
constraints: Do not silently choose between competing owners.
Block duplicate candidates until reconciled.
Retain one physical path identity.
subskills.failure: Block only conflicted path contributions and report candidate owners.

subskills.task: Identify AHUs and supported system types from mechanical plans, schematics, and schedules; distinguish equipment from symbols, legends, and unrelated notes.
constraints: Only supported system types may be proposed.
Do not infer capacity or airflow from equipment appearance.
Stable IDs must not depend on response order.
subskills.failure: Retain uncertain candidates as needs_review; invalid topology is blocked.

subskills.task: Map each AHU to served zones and rooms using explicit schedules, tags, duct paths, and terminal references; identify complete and conflicting ownership.
constraints: Do not assign rooms solely by proximity.
A room/zone cannot be silently assigned to multiple systems.
VAV terminal coverage must be explicit.
subskills.failure: Block only ambiguous system ownership and retain alternatives.

subskills.task: Reconcile supply, return, outside, exhaust, relief, transfer, make-up, and leakage air paths against room-level airflow ownership.
constraints: Normalize units through the existing validator.
Detect central/room-level double counting.
Do not infer missing path flow.
subskills.failure: Keep conflicted paths blocked; valid unrelated AHUs may continue.

subskills.task: Resolve schedules, state points, fan heat, duct gains/losses, leakage effects, heat recovery, and preconditioning from cited evidence or controlled scoped profiles.
constraints: Do not invent psychrometric states or equipment performance.
Validate finite values and applicability.
Mark controlled values as preliminary assumptions.
subskills.failure: Exclude only affected AHU component where required operands are missing.

subskills.task: Assemble eligible AHU coil inputs from validated coincident room/zone loads, airflow, state points, and component records for the existing Stage 9 calculator.
constraints: Do not sum non-coincident room peaks.
Do not modify reviewed AHU artifacts.
Use existing Stage 9 equations only.
subskills.failure: Produce only eligible partial subtotal and list excluded AHUs/components.

subskills.task: Identify chillers, boilers, heat pumps, package units, and number-off from plant schedules, schematics, and equipment tags; classify duty basis only when stated.
constraints: Do not infer capacity from nameplate appearance unless legible and cited.
Keep heating/refrigerant systems out of cooling subtotal unless supported by existing engine.
IDs must be stable.
subskills.failure: Retain classification candidates; block unsupported duty.

subskills.task: Trace chilled-water, heating-water, refrigerant, and hydraulic circuits and map AHU coils to exactly one cited circuit and plant where drawings support the path.
constraints: Do not infer connections from diagram proximity alone.
Flag duplicate, missing, or competing ownership.
Keep incompatible circuit types separate.
subskills.failure: Block only unresolved mappings; do not invent a circuit.

subskills.task: Resolve pump identity, number-off, power, flow, duty/standby, and schedule from cited pump schedules or released scoped records.
constraints: Do not turn pump presence into assumed power.
Do not count standby power as coincident duty without policy.
Retain units and citations.
subskills.failure: Keep pump contribution unresolved/excluded without preventing eligible plant duty.

subskills.task: Resolve pipe heat gain/loss only from documented route, insulation, temperature, or an applicable released profile; keep effect direction and schedule explicit.
constraints: Do not assume uninsulated pipe or thermal effect without evidence.
Do not double count pipe effects already included in coil duty.
Unknown is not zero.
subskills.failure: Exclude only unresolved pipe effect and report its impact as unknown.

subskills.task: Reconcile plant duty with same-hour AHU coil duty and apply only cited diversity/number-off treatment once using existing Stage 10 equations.
constraints: Never sum independent AHU peak hours.
Do not apply diversity or number-off more than once.
Reviewed plant files remain untouched.
subskills.failure: Suppress complete plant peak when ownership or coincidence is unresolved.

subskills.task: Find an explicit project brief, engineer instruction, or approved rule for cooling/heating safety factors and record citation, scope, and approval state.
constraints: Do not invent factors or treat a draft fallback as reviewed approval.
Normalize percent/multiplier only when unambiguous.
subskills.failure: Reviewed final total remains blocked without approved cited policy.

subskills.task: Inspect room, zone, AHU, plant, and project inputs for active safety factors to ensure policy-mode aggregation cannot apply a factor more than once.
constraints: Do not silently neutralize or rewrite reviewed inputs.
Any active duplicate factor blocks policy-mode calculation.
subskills.failure: Fail closed with the exact double-application source and affected IDs.

subskills.task: Select the governing hour from coincident project component loads, then apply the approved cooling/heating factor once at project rollup and expose raw total, allowance, final total, and source.
constraints: Do not add non-coincident room peaks.
Do not alter component formulas.
Draft and reviewed eligibility remain distinct.
subskills.failure: Do not emit a complete final total when policy or component scope is unresolved.

subskills.task: Normalize current domain-resolution records into the shared value register while preserving each domain artifact as authoritative and retaining source chains, operands, confidence, and impact.
constraints: Do not overwrite domain records with normalized copies.
Reject unaccepted/expired/out-of-scope research candidates.
Exclude only affected components.
subskills.failure: Retain unresolved fields and their affected component IDs.

subskills.task: Compare source, AI, prompt, domain, pack, override, schedule, weather, and method-gate fingerprints to identify stale current proposals and dependent reports.
constraints: Do not rewrite historical snapshots or reports.
Mark only dependent current artifacts stale.
subskills.failure: Fail readiness for stale dependencies and name the required rebuild.

subskills.task: Audit every governing-hour contribution for source/assumption, evidence citation, formula, unrounded operands, confidence, and affected component lineage.
constraints: Do not claim provenance from uncited AI text.
Keep historical artifact bytes unchanged.
subskills.failure: Flag missing lineage and suppress complete-project readiness where required.

subskills.task: Determine whether the current result is complete, included-scope only, provisional, blocked, or stale by checking required coverage, exclusions, gates, policy, and provenance.
constraints: Never label a draft or partial scope as a complete validated building design load.
Do not infer missing artifact readiness from 0/0 coverage.
subskills.failure: Block readiness and provide direct remediation to each missing dependency.

subskills.task: List the information the heat-load calculation still needs that the drawing set does not give and cannot reasonably be worked out from it, so the operators know exactly what to research or ask the client. First infer everything the drawings support, showing the working; only what remains goes on the list.
constraints: Never list information that is printed in the case file or can reasonably be worked out from it; infer it instead and show the working.
Never invent a value to avoid listing a need; an unsupported value stays a need.
Each need names one concrete thing to find (e.g. the combi oven's rated power), not a category.
subskills.failure: List every required calculation input without a supported value as a need.
